derivative.def: \(f'(a)=\lim_{h\to0}\frac{f(a+h)-f(a)}{h}\): the slope of the tangent, the rate at which \(f\) changes.

partial-derivative.def: \(\partial f/\partial x_j\): the slope of \(f\) when only \(x_j\) moves and every other input is held fixed.

gradient.def: \(\nabla f\): the vector of all partial derivatives. Points steepest uphill, perpendicular to contours.

gradient-descent.def: Repeat \(\boldsymbol\phi\leftarrow\boldsymbol\phi-\alpha\nabla L\): small steps downhill with learning rate \(\alpha\).

chain-rule.def: \(\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy}{du}\frac{du}{dx}\): sensitivities along a chain of functions multiply.

computational-graph.def: A calculation drawn as boxes of elementary steps; values flow forwards, derivatives flow backwards (backpropagation).

gradient-check.def: Comparing a hand-derived gradient with a central-difference estimate via their relative error.

convex.def: A function whose chords lie above its graph (\(f''\ge0\)); any stationary point is the global minimum.
